top.title: Etihad Rail Al Dhaid station opens: ‘Best option’ for Abu Dhabi trips, say passengers
top.teaser: Al Dhaid joined the UAE’s national passenger railway on Wednesday, giving Sharjah its first Etihad Rail station and connecting the emirate to Fujairah and Abu Dhabi. The new station in Muragabat serves as a rail gateway for central Sharjah and nearby communities, including Shawka. top.impact_reason: Improves regional transport connectivity and accessibility.
top.headline: Al Dhaid opens Sharjah's first Etihad Rail station
top.summary: Al Dhaid has opened Sharjah's inaugural Etihad Rail station in Muragabat. This connects the central region directly to Fujairah and Abu Dhabi.
top.why: New transport links enhance regional accessibility and property appeal.

top.title: Dubai developers hold off-plan prices steady as only 6% cut prices by 5% or more since February
top.teaser: Developers in Dubai have largely held off-plan prices steady through 2026 as sales volumes and absorption rates adjust, according to fäm Properties. 44 of the 717 off-plan projects launched since July 2023 have reduced prices by 5 per cent or more since the end of February, while only 28 projects, or 4 per cent, are currently selling below their original launch price, as per the market analysis. top.impact_reason: Indicates steady developer pricing and healthy market confidence.
top.headline: Dubai developers keep off-plan prices mostly stable
top.summary: Dubai off-plan prices have remained largely steady throughout 2026 according to fäm Properties data. Only a small fraction of launched projects reduced prices by five percent or more.
top.why: Price stability reflects sustained developer confidence and steady demand.

top.headline: Aldar and Arada form Dh15 billion Abu Dhabi partnership
